thread:
Ana (PM): quick sync — want to lock the trial -> tier entry flow before we freeze the Q3 pricing ship. thoughts?
Matt (Product Ops): customers keep tripping over credits vs quota. simpler funnel pls.
Ryan (Pricing): proposal: trial credits convert into a 30-day microcommit (soft cap), UI prompt if 7-day avg > 60% of soft cap. auto-extend option when they accept terms.
Jess (Sales): strong yes. need a pilot bypass for demo weeks — reps must temporarily lift soft cap.
Ana (PM): OK. launch gating criteria? product + legal + ops checks?
Ryan (Pricing): gating KPIs: conversion (trial->paid) >= 6%, billing flow complaints <4% of trial cohort, CAC vs LTV within model.
Matt (Product Ops): ops gating: telemetry validated on 10 pilot accounts, per-route latency stable, alerting hooks in Console for rate-limit errors.
Jess (Sales): sales asks: a one-click playbook to request temporary surge for pilot accounts.
legal-bot: flagged — need an MSA pilot clause for temporary capacity exceptions and automatic expiry. will draft.
Ana (PM): feature scope: include a low-cost "surge pack" at GA or hold until pilots?
Ryan (Pricing): hold. surface the option as a disabled UI slot so we can flip it quickly if pilots demand it.
Matt (Product Ops): tech note — surge pack needs priority routing + queue tokens. infra ETA ~3w to wire canary path and feature flag.
Jess (Sales): that timeline is workable if pilots start now. can we get an internal request form/playbook?
Ana (PM): action list: Ryan -> KPIs draft; Matt -> infra checklist + lead times; legal-bot -> MSA clause draft; Jess -> list of 8 pilot customers.
Ryan (Pricing): posting KPI draft by EOD into /product/docs.
Matt (Product Ops): will post infra checklist in #eng-platform and link here.
legal-bot: uploaded draft clause to drive:link/msa-pilot-clause (internal).
Jess (Sales): pinging @partners to secure pilot slots.
Ana (PM): final Q — lock per-route throughput add-on for GA?
Ryan (Pricing): defer. GA add-ons: conceptual priority lane only. keep per-route throughput for later.
Matt (Product Ops): keep add-ons behind flags so we can enable per-customer without deploys. saves ops cycles.
Ana (PM): great. we’ll reconvene after pilot KPIs. thanks all :thumbsup:
